rationale: The stock gapped down ~7.7% on earnings despite a strong beat, suggesting the market had already priced in optimism or there are concerns not fully captured in the headline metrics (North Italia mentioned as a caveat). Price has recovered significantly from the $97.55 low to $106.08, now sitting at 78.6% of today's range and above VWAP/9-EMA, but the last five 1-minute candles show decelerating momentum with declining volume on the most recent bars. With 145 minutes to close and no clear directional edge — the gap-fill thesis is partially played out and a short against the recovery lacks a clean catalyst — the risk/reward does not favor initiating a new position at this mid-range location.
